stories.title: Ontario career college forced into layoffs as student funding stalls
stories.summary: A school that says it plays by the rules warns that continuing to withhold student funding hurts Ontario’s workforce and could put good actors out of business.

stories.title: Leafs undone by more mistakes in 5th straight loss
stories.summary: Auston Matthews saw a familiar script unfold.

stories.title: Toronto orthodox priest criticized for accepting medal from Putin
stories.summary: The Ukrainian Canadian Congress said it was disgraceful that Father Vladimir Malchenko shook hands with Putin two days after Russia bombed a school in Ukraine, killing 55.

stories.title: Boldy’s hat trick sends Leafs to 5th straight loss
stories.summary: Matt Boldy completed his second hat trick of the season and the sixth of his career early in the third period as the Minnesota Wild resigned the Toronto Maple Leafs to a fifth straight regulation home loss with a 5-2 victory Thursday.

stories.title: Ontario to cap OSAP growth at career colleges following massive increases
stories.summary: The legislation is set to include the as-yet undefined cap, limit OSAP funding to in-person and hybrid programs at those institutions and require them to have a physical location.

stories.title: U of T rejects report, recommendations on anti-Muslim, anti-Arab discrimination
stories.summary: The nearly 300-page report is based on consultations with 85 people and small groups as well as 525 responses to a survey of students, staff, faculty and librarians.

stories.title: Association of Quebec farmers releases study challenging costs of high-speed rail
stories.summary: The study conducted by Vision Transport and agricultural group Union des producteurs agricoles say these savings could be made by modernizing existing tracks.

stories.title: Two Sudbury officers charged with obstruction after man’s carbon monoxide death
stories.summary: Two Sudbury police officers have been charged with obstructing justice in connection to a 19-year-old man’s carbon monoxide death last year.

stories.title: Winning Mississauga Lotto 6/49 Gold Ball ticket worth $38M: OLG
stories.summary: A winning Lotto 6/49 Gold Ball ticket sold in Mississauga is worth $38 million, the Ontario Lottery and Gaming Corporation (OLG) says.

stories.title: ‘I’m fed up’: Mélanie Joly says Stellantis must repay Ottawa, or it will sue
stories.summary: A letter from Industry Minister Mélanie Joly dated Nov. 12 says Stellantis is in default of the agreement because it halted Jeep Compass production at the plant.
